observations: Salomone et al., F1000Research (2014), reported early post-transplant GGT and survival in 522 adult liver-transplant recipients.

entities.name: Early GGT and survival
observations: In 522 adult liver-transplant recipients, higher early recipient serum GGT was associated with better 90-day survival; peak median 293 vs 172 U/L in survivors vs non-survivors (p<0.0001), and Kaplan–Meier comparison favored higher GGT (p<0.001).
This observational early association does not establish causation; late post-transplant GGT showed the opposite association with 5-year survival.
